description: a component-scoped `#{}`: the component's root carries its per-file scope key `data-scrml="card~<file tag>"`.
rationale: §9.1 DQ-7: "The constructor's root element SHALL carry the attribute `data-scrml=\"ConstructorName\"`", as re-ruled S474 (user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — permanent-restrictions re-review: the four one-way doors", item 3): "The CSS scope key and output names are always per-file qualified, not only on a collision." The key is `<name>~<file tag>` (compiler/self-host-v2/core.scrml scopeKey); the case pins its shape (the name, then `~`), not the hash.
